title: pvSEPReader
body:
## pvSEPReader

Reads Stanford Exploration Project seismic data: a text .H header describing up to 32 named axes (labels such as CDP, LINE, OFFSET, DEPTH) with their sizes, origins and sampling, which points to the raw .H@ data file. You choose which named axes become the output x, y and z (or x and y for 2-D output) and hold the remaining axes at one index each; the result is uniform image data with an ImageScalars array.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Axis names must match the header labels; when the header has no labels, VTK assigns the default names to the first axes in order.
- Choose different axes for x, y, z and the fixed dimensions; reusing one axis collapses that direction.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SEPReader`. Identity: `sources/SEPReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ExtentSplitMode` | This property specifies the extent mode. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XSlab","YSlab","ZSlab","Block"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"XSlab"` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the SEP reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FixedDimension1` | Name of an extra SEP axis that is not mapped to x, y or z; the output is the single slice at FixedDimension1Value along it (for example one offset of a prestack volume). | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FixedDimension1Value` | Zero-based index along FixedDimension1 of the slice to read, e.g. which offset gather. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FixedDimension2` | Name of a second fixed SEP axis, used only with 2-D output (OutputGridDimension 2D): the axis that would otherwise be z is held at FixedDimension2Value. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FixedDimension2Value` | Zero-based index along FixedDimension2 of the slice to read in 2-D output; ignored for 3-D output. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OutputGridDimension` | This property specifies the dimension of the output data set. | `{"type":"enum","values":["2D","3D"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"2D"` |
| `XDimension` | Name of the SEP axis mapped to the output x direction; that axis's origin and sampling in the header become the image's x origin and spacing. It must be one of the axis labels in the .H header. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `YDimension` | Name of the SEP axis mapped to the output y direction, supplying the image's y origin and spacing. It must be one of the axis labels in the .H header. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ZDimension` | Name of the SEP axis mapped to the output z direction. Only used when OutputGridDimension is 3D; in 2-D output this axis is not used and FixedDimension2 is held fixed instead. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSEPReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
